text.p: America West Airlines Inc Monday announced lower fares for air travel to cities across the United States and western Mexico.

In a statement, the airline said it dropped its seven-day advance purchase fares on select shorter-range day flights as low as $79 each way based on round-trip purchase. Select cross-country day flights start as low as $199 each way based on round-trip purchase. Lower three-day advance purchase fares are available in many sale markets for night flights.

Most sale fares are good for travel through March 23, 1997. Florida travel must be completed by Feb. 10, 1997 and Mexico travel must be completed by Feb. 27, 1997. Non-refundable tickets must be purchased within 72 hours for day flights and by midnight local time on the day of reservation for night flights, but no later than Friday.
The airline said an evening flight from New York to Burbank, Calif. will now cost $199 each way based on a round trip ticket. A daytime flight will cost $239 each way.
